page.help: Turn single commands, or whole groups of commands, on or off for this server. A command that is off only answers with a short notice. /commands and /configwizard always stay on, so you cannot lock yourself out.

bot.title: Bot settings
bot.help: Basic settings for how Mewvo works in this server. You can also change these with /configwizard in Discord.
bot.prefixHelp: Some commands also work in a normal message: type this sign and then the command name, instead of using a slash command. 1 to 10 characters, no spaces.
bot.modRoleHelp: Members with this role can use moderation commands. They can also log in to this dashboard as moderators: they see members, cases and appeals, and can warn, mute, unmute, kick and time out. They cannot ban or change settings. Mewvo never gives this role to anyone by itself.
bot.needsAdmin: To change bot settings and use the utilities here you need the Administrator permission in this server.
bot.prefixRule: The prefix must be 1 to 10 characters, with no spaces.
bot.modRoleAuto: Moderator role: @{role} is {where}, so everyone who gets it would become a moderator. Pick a staff-only role.

where.autoRole: the auto role given on join

utilities.title: Utilities
utilities.help: Shorten a link with is.gd, as /shorten. The short link is shown at the top of this page.
utilities.urlHelp: Turns a long web link into a short one that is easier to share.
utilities.customHelp: Choose the last part of the short link yourself. Letters, numbers, _ and - only.

list.title: Commands
list.notLoaded: The command list is not loaded yet. Reload the page in a moment.
list.moduleHelp: The slash commands that belong to this page. A command you turn off only answers with a short notice. The Commands page lists every command.
list.topicLine: The slash commands that belong to this page.

every.title: Every command ({count})
every.retiredText: Admin commands are switched off in Discord. Only the commands for everyone, the bot owner's emergency tools and {test} are left. Everything else is done here on the dashboard.
every.notRetiredText: Every command works in Discord. The bot owner can switch admin commands off, so that only the commands for everyone, the emergency tools and {test} stay, and everything else is done on the dashboard.
every.ifRetired: If admin commands are switched off
every.support: Also in the support server: {list}. Who can use which command is fixed in Mewvo and cannot be changed here.
